scripts.db:lint: supabase db lint --linked --schema public --level warning --fail-on error
scripts.db:types: supabase gen types typescript --linked --schema public > packages/contracts/src/database.types.ts
scripts.clean: rm -rf .turbo && find . -name 'node_modules' -type d -prune -exec rm -rf '{}' + && find . -name '.next' -type d -prune -exec rm -rf '{}' + && rm -f package-lock.json + && pnpm install
